neutral: When you Cast, you may Replenish one Resource type.
unaligned: During your Season, if anyone Gathers from the Resource you Replenished, gain 1 Influence.

neutral: Upon completing a Building adjacent to a Lake, gain 2 Stone.
aligned: When completing a Water Building, gain x2 Influence from completion bonuses.
unaligned: Once per turn, you may use 2 Crystals to change the tile you're standing below or on into a Floodplains.
goal1: Build one Water Building. (Aqueduct, Bath, Sewers, Fishing Spot)

neutral: Refund all Resources from completing the final Layer of a Building.
aligned: Upon visiting a Building you do not own, you may additionally take the Owner Visit Bonus.
unaligned: You may trade 1 Crystal for 1 of any other Resource once per turn.

neutral: You can have 2 Invitations. Completing a Invitation gives you +3 Influence.
aligned: Upon completing a Cursed Invitation, you may assign the Invitation to another player.
unaligned: Hanging Invitations are half the cost to complete.

neutral: After reading an Event, you may roll 1d6. If you roll even, redraw that Event.
aligned: When you draw an Event, draw +1 Event, pick 1 Event, then resolve.
unaligned: During your neutral ability's roll, if you roll odd, you may gain 1 Resource of any kind.

neutral: +1 wood on Gathering on Forest Tiles.
aligned: +1 wood on all Gathers (total +2 wood on Forest Gathers.)
unaligned: (Replaces ability) +1 Stone or Marble on Quarry or Basin Gathers.
goal1: Have 10 Wood in your inventory at one moment.

neutral: +2 on Populate rolls. You gain any overflowed resources.
aligned: Before Gathering, Repopulate that Resource Tile.
unaligned: Roll a Populate dice for Gathers.
goal1: Get 5 of each Resource. (Track on the side of your Player Board.)

neutral: Layers for Marble-foundation buildings cost 1 less Marble.
aligned: (Replaces Ability) All Layers cost 1 less of one type of Resource.
unaligned: When another Player Gains 5 or 6 Marble, take 1 from them.

neutral: Casting loses you 1 Influence. Whenever you acquire a sigil, gain 1 Influence.
aligned: All Sigil gaining events or purchases are half their cost.
unaligned: Upon entering this Alignment, discard all your Sigils. For each Sigil discarded, gain 2 Influence.

aligned: When placing a Resource Tile, gain 2 of that Resource.
unaligned: You may take an Exploration Event instead of a Normal Event. Place the new Tile at the closest location off the board.

aligned: Upon entering this Alignment, Gather Marble or Crystal.
unaligned: Upon entering this Alignment, Gather Wood or Stone.
goal1: Align then Unalign back-to-back. (If you Align Neutral between, it doesn't count.)

neutral: At the start of the game, +1 Speed, +1 Crystal.
aligned: Walking over a Resource Tile gives you +1 of that Resource. Remove said pips.
unaligned: (Replaces Ability) Gain Advantage on all rolls.
